mapper.sql: select k.key_id, k.name, k.user_id, u.user_name, k.status, k.expires_time, k.last_used_time, k.create_by, k.create_time, k.update_by, k.update_time, k.remark from oauth_api_key k left join sys_user u on u.user_id = k.user_id
mapper.select: select k.key_id, k.name, k.key_hash, k.user_id, u.user_name, k.status, k.expires_time, k.last_used_time from oauth_api_key k left join sys_user u on u.user_id = k.user_id where k.key_hash = #{keyHash} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into oauth_api_key ( name, key_hash, user_id, status, expires_time, create_by, create_time, remark ) values ( #{name}, #{keyHash}, #{userId}, #{status}, #{expiresTime}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark} )
mapper.delete:
delete from oauth_api_key where key_id in
#{keyId}
mapper.update: update oauth_api_key set last_used_time = #{lastUsedTime} where key_id = #{keyId}
